verdict.rationale: Vapi's HIPAA docs say users can choose approved transcriber providers, which implies the STT provider is configurable. Its multilingual docs mention automatic language detection. Both are only glancing mentions, and the pronunciation dictionary (TTS) and denoising features are adjacent, so they earn no credit. missing for 10: explicit docs on configuring the transcriber/STT provider, selecting the STT model or language, key-term boosting, real-time transcript delivery, and accuracy evidence or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can get accurate real-time transcription with control over the STT provider, language models, or key terms

citations.quote: use approved LLM, voice, and transcriber providers
